about: The preview gallery's ask queue after the orchestrator's q26 ruling (run-answers orchestrator-B14-Q26-RULING-2026-11-24): 1 SCR, 2 EXP, 3 AUD (his page picks of 14 Nov), 4 DSK (his desktop look at 1920x1080 and 1440x900, on the retired IPAD card's walk) and 5 SPD (speed with his own games); IPAD retired under CLAUDE.md's Parked line. Graded by gate 15 at 375x679 (CT_G15_GEOS=kunal): the queue pin (PINNED_IDS, in order) and the two-sided board pin (EXPECT_BOARD: AUD and DSK paint a board on their walks, SPD does not on a fresh store).
checks: ^kunal: every caption whose card is pinned to show a board showed one

breaks.name: ipad-card-back-in-the-queue
breaks.why: the retired IPAD card is back in the queue in DSK's place - the Parked line broken - so the queue reads SCR|EXP|AUD|IPAD|SPD against the pin. Strengthened at #553 B1 (15:56Z run read BLIND): the first version changed the id only, and the pin reads the queue from the card labels, which still said DSK

breaks.name: audit-picks-card-dropped
breaks.why: the audit-picks card is missing, so the queue holds four cards where the pin names five

breaks.name: desktop-card-walks-nothing
breaks.why: the desktop card walks none of the board screens - it stays on Discover - so its caption, pinned to show a board, shows none.
